description: Source code for reporting API endpoints in Mattermost, including user and post reporting with permission checks, cursor-based pagination, and report export functions.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct with route initialization for reports.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object used for handling request permissions, errors, and app interactions.

methods.name: getUsersForReporting
methods.description: Handles retrieval of user reports with permission checks and pagination.

methods.name: getUserCountForReporting
methods.description: Returns count of users matching report criteria.

methods.name: startUsersBatchExport
methods.description: Starts a batch export of user data, permission-restricted to system admins.

methods.name: fillReportingBaseOptions
methods.description: Builds base report options from URL query parameters.

methods.name: fillUserReportOptions
methods.description: Builds user report options from URL query parameters, with validation.

methods.name: getPostsForReporting
methods.description: Retrieves posts for reporting with cursor-based pagination, permission checks, and channel validation.
